sql: with t as ( select pt.market_ticker, pt.created_at, pt.pnl, m.event_ticker, substring(m.event_ticker from position('-' in m.event_ticker)+1) as contest from paper_trades pt join mmsell_settlement_meta m on m.market_ticker = pt.market_ticker where pt.strategy = 'mmsell10' and pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and pt.created_at >= timestamptz '2026-08-13 18:09:40+00' and m.event_ticker is not null ), r as ( select *, row_number() over (partition by contest order by created_at) as rn from t ) select count(*) as n_all, count(distinct contest) as contests, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2) as pnl_all, round((100*avg(pnl))::numeric,3) as c_all, count(*) filter (where rn<=1) as n1, round(sum(pnl) filter (where rn<=1)::numeric,2) as pnl1, round((100*avg(pnl) filter (where rn<=1))::numeric,3) as c1, count(*) filter (where rn<=2) as n2, round(sum(pnl) filter (where rn<=2)::numeric,2) as pnl2, round((100*avg(pnl) filter (where rn<=2))::numeric,3) as c2, count(*) filter (where rn<=3) as n3, round(sum(pnl) filter (where rn<=3)::numeric,2) as pnl3, round((100*avg(pnl) filter (where rn<=3))::numeric,3) as c3 from r
